manuscript_or_work: Wellcome MS.708; Johannes de Rupescissa, De consideratione quintae essentiae
exact_supporting_statement: Medicinal extraction by distillation of essence from wine, plants, and minerals; book one distillation and book two remedies.
Body-like top-to-bottom side-pipe vessel; repeated ascent/descent; quintessence separated from four elements; head/foot/stomach analogy.

manuscript_or_work: British Library Sloane MS 2560; Donum Dei
exact_supporting_statement: Eleven painted process miniatures; f7 chemical union of red king and white queen; later black/white flasks, man, flower, and red/white roses.
Rounded divided vessel contains figures/faces, has one rising curved side spout, and supports branching green forms.
